newsitem.title: CHINA: Sinar Mas signs $18.5 mln contract with Samsung.
newsitem.headline: Sinar Mas signs $18.5 mln contract with Samsung.

text.p: The Sinar Mas Group on Friday signed a contract worth $18.5 million with Samsung Corp, a unit of Samsung Group, for substructuring construction work on the $460-million Bund Finance Centre in Shanghai, a company spokesman said.

The centre, one of a number of major investments planned in China by the Indonesian investment group, is due for completion in 1999. It comprises a 50-storey office tower, two 27-storey blocks of apartments and a retail podium.
The contract awarded to Samsung covers the construction of the building's three-storey basement, the spokesman said.
